stages.name: Technical qualification
checks: standard Arcade starts with Toadal
real gameplay loop operates
opaque-origin isolation holds
host pause/resume/visibility works
host fullscreen/exit works
no unexpected network egress
no fatal console/page errors
package provenance and hashes recorded

stages.name: Three-character demo
checks: website chooser exposes only toadal/classic/pelican
Toadal starts unlocked
Classic unlocks after first completed run
Gully unlocks at bestScore>=600 OR completedRuns>=3
Gully display name is used while runtime id remains pelican
all three characters can start and finish Standard Arcade runs
preview unlocks do not mutate canonical mobile coinCost
preview unlocks do not write to froggyFeast mobile save
best score and unlock state persist via host-owned isolated namespace
result screen shows score/best/unlock before app conversion
no interruptive app CTA appears during gameplay

stages.name: Optimization and polish
checks: natural run duration is measured before deciding on a hard timer
runtime request/reachability ledger captured
only proven-unreachable files are removed
package requalified after every bounded trim set
phone/tablet/desktop layouts pass
final screenshots show Toadal, Classic and Gully states
full-game CTA is strongest after web-roster completion or repeat engagement
